newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Credito Argentino says Frances buys 16.4 pct stake.
newsitem.headline: Credito Argentino says Frances buys 16.4 pct stake.

text.p: Banco de Credito Argentino, controlled by Argentina's Banco Frances, said Thursday shareholder Fernando de Santibanes sold an additional 16.42 percent stake to Frances for an undisclosed amount.
The deal was closed June 3, Credito told the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange.
Santibanes up to that date owned a 28 percent stake in Credito.
Frances, controlled by Spain's Banco de Bilbao Vizcaya, last month bought 71.8 percent of Credito for $466 million.
According to local media reports, Bilbao's officials said Frances wanted to buy all the shares owned by Santibanes.
Bilbao also has interests in Mexico, Colombia and Peru. ((-- Guillermo Haskel, Buenos Aires newsroom, 541 318-0650))
